newsitem.title: USA: Ergo starts Ergostat with insulin study.
newsitem.headline: Ergo starts Ergostat with insulin study.

text.p: Ergo Science Corp said Tuesday that it has started a human clinical study to evaluate safety and efficacy of its timed, orally administered Ergoset tablets given in combination with insulin for Type II diabetes patients.
The study is for patients who no longer can be controlled with traditional forms of treatment called oral hypoglycemic agents (OHAs).

The company said it has demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful Phase III human clinical trial results for Ergoset tablets in Type II diabetics who do not currently require insulin.
It said it remains on track to submit its NDA in mid-1997 for Ergoset tablets as both a monotherapy and adjunctive therapy.
